description: On their way to school Paul and Fiona find and help a Professor Wagstaff who's trapped inside his new, untested time machine, so beginning an adventure that will send them back and forth through their local history.

Title: 779. Aakhri Daku
description: Mangal Singh played by Vinod Khanna is a dreaded dacoit of the Chambal valley who mercilessly loots people and kills them and has a reward of Rs. 5000 on his head which becomes Rs.50,000. His lady love is Champa, played by Reena Roy, who wants him to leave this life and get married to her. On the other side of the coin is Bhola, a village simpleton, extremely honest and religious, who is very poor and so is scolded by his mother played by Achala Sachdev. Taking offense he decides to end his life and in the process is caught by Mangal Singh's aides, who take him to Mangal Singh. When Mangal Singh comes to know that Bhola wanted to end his life due to poverty, he trades with him that as Mangal Singh's true identity is not known by the police, Bhola should become Mangal Singh, get caught deliberately and hang instead of him, whence the real Mangal Singh will collect the reward of Rs.50,000 from the government and give to Bhola's family. The course of events however reveal that Mangal Singh is in reality Bhola's true brother. Also Bhola's lady love, played by Rekha will not let him commit suicide and chides him for running after money. The police however have already recognized Bhola as dacoit Mangal Singh. Will Bhola's stance be vindicated and what will be the fate of the real dacoit Mangal Singh?

Title: 782. Jaganmohini
description: Jaganmohini (Jayamalini) commits suicide and becomes a ghost after getting betrayed by a king on the pretext of marriage. Later, the king is reborn as Raja (Narasimha Raju) and is married to a pious woman Gowri (Prabha). Mohini, now a ghost, plans to take away Raja from this world permanently. Can Gowri fight against the magical spells of Mohini and get her husband back?

Title: 783. Bhola Bhala
description: Ram Kumar Verma is an honest albeit unsuccessful Insurance Agent. His poor performance and a quick settlement for Renu and her mom gets him transferred to Madhya Pradesh. During the train journey he comes across Nathu Singh, and thinking that Nathu is an emperor of sorts, gets him to insure himself for Rs.5 lakhs, to which Nathu Singh agrees. Ram Verma returns to his company and is heartily congratulated by his Manager and the General Manager even throws a party for Ram. Subsequently, the Manager realizes that the person Ram has insured is actually a wanted dacait and thug commonly known as Daku Nathiya, wanted by the police dead or alive. Fearing the collapse of the insurance company, the Manager coerces Ram to return to Madhya Pradesh and get Nathiya to cancel his insurance policy. Ram, in the interest of the insurance company, readily agrees and on the way to meet Nathiya, ends up saving Nathiya's son from a burning house, thus earning Nathiya's and his woman, Champa's gratitude. Ram finds out that Nathiya was otherwise known as Nathu Singh, a honest villager, with a beautiful wife, and a son Chander. A rich village lord, Thakur Ajit Singh, rapes and kills Nathu's wife, and as Nathu is unable to get justice, he turns into Nathiya, the dacait. Ram only wants Nathiya to cancel the policy, so that he can return home, and promises not to inform the police. Nathiya agrees to cancel the insurance policy and let Ram return home. But Sambha is not pleased with the favors being showered on Ram and rebels, and forces Nathiya to keep Ram prisoner. When Nathiya is injured, Champa asks Ram to bring in a medical doctor, and Ram brings Renu, and ultimately both Ram and Renu are also held by Sambha, while Nathiya lies unconscious. Meanwhile the police have launched a dragnet to capture Nathiya dead of alive. Will Ram and Renu return home to Ram's mother and sister, Sarla and his best friend Babu Khan? Will Nathiya and Champa survive the police dragnet?

Title: 784. La güera Rodríguez
description: In 1809 María Ignacia Rodríguez Velasco de Osorio, La güera Rodríguez, was accused before the viceroy, by her husband Jerónimo, of adultery, because he discovered Simón Bolívar gloves in her house.

Title: 785. Suave, cariño, muy suave
description: Luis is a seller of beauty products for women. He is attractive and manly but very shy, which increases his attractiveness and popularity among his clients.

Title: 786. Quiet Is the Night
description: A psychological detective story about a police hunt for the murderer of young boys during the Christmas season. The police commissioner ends up tracing the clues to his own home, where he has an adolescent son with whom he has difficult relationship.

Title: 787. At the Service of Spanish Womanhood
description: A sexually dissatisfied woman is confronted with a man who is the victim of a puritanic education.

Title: 788. Lulu
description: This highly stylized film mixes silent film cards, a soundscape, color, opera music and atmosphere to explore the Freudian truths about men's fear of women that Wedekind powerfully exposed. A kinetic melodrama of the rise of a femme-fatale and her fate at the hands of Jack-the-Ripper. Rethinking Pabst's silent film and Alban Berg's opera.

Title: 790. Las truchas
description: In a restaurant they're preparing a grand banquet in honor of a sports association of anglers, but several circumstances seem to have conspired to boycott the event.

Title: 791. Just Tell Me You Love Me
description: Four teens meet by chance at a Hawaii airport, sparking romance and wild adventures across the tropical paradise.

Title: 792. Obyasneniye v lyubvi
description: The life of Filipok, a young man with a romantic personality, which happens in the first half of the 20th century in Soviet Russia. Filipok finds love with a young women, Zinochka who is of aristocratic roots.

Title: 793. Sketches of a Strangler
description: An art student living with his sister is actually a maniac strangling dancers and prostitutes. One victim's sister starts looking for him...

Title: 795. L'amour en question
description: Architect Dumas dies from a bullet of his own gun in front of his house. The police suspects his young Swedish wife Catherine and her English lover Tom Hastings. After numerous interrogations, in which they entangle themselves in contradictions, they try to flee, but are soon both caught and brought to trial, he in England, she in France. Only when Catherine keeps on proclaiming her innocence, superintendent Corbier finally considers believing her.

Title: 796. O Cortiço
description: This adaptation of a classic Brazilian novel focuses on the relations of charismatic characters within a tenement.

Title: 797. Letter from Beirut
description: Dreamlike, melancholy, and cautiously hopeful, this epistolary film finds Saab returning to a Beirut that has irrevocably changed, where she wanders the streets, rides buses, chats with refugees and peacekeepers, and reflects on the war's toll during a brief moment of peace.

Title: 798. Chu zhong
description: It's triad turf wars and the control of Kowloon's Ho's springs the gangs into violent Kung Fu kicking action.

Title: 799. Ward Six
description: A doctor from provincial town in Tsardom of Russia meets his former student in Ward 6, where the story takes place. Impressed by his rebellious spirit and clever remarks, he tends to spend more time with him while also indulging in meditation, only to be ridiculed by his fellow colleagues. Based on a Chekhov's work of the same title.

Title: 800. The Legendary Strike
description: The plot deals with a search for a valuable pearl, dubbed the Buddha's Relic, which is sold to an unwitting Japanese emissary by a corrupt Ching Dynasty prince who seeks to steal it back for his own purposes.

Title: 801. Made in Iran
description: Ali is a young boxer pursuing his dream of becoming a champion, but he's soon approached by a gangster. He gets involved--agreeing to follow their terms. He wins boxing matches and everything is going okay until they order him to lose a match.

Title: 802. Dost Asava Tar Asa
description: The Film Is Based on True Friendship of two friends.

Title: 804. American Fever
description: Young king of the dance halls dreams of becoming a movie star. Unfortunately, there are those who exploit his ambitions and his generous character.

Title: 805. Rooster: Spurs of Death!
description: Stoke and his son Wyatt take their prize roosters to a cock fight, only to find deceit and cheating by a competitor has forced them to lose their winnings. On the way, Wyatt learns about love from a runaway hooker and that maybe the "cocker" trade is not right for him.

Title: 806. Anjaam
description: A mansion's new owner deals with the mystery surrounding it, as well as it's previous owner's wife.

Title: 807. The Phoenix
description: An alien visits Earth and casts an evil spell over a poor fisherman who finds her magic container that can generate anything. Since this container can generate anything, soon the fisherman finds that several criminals are after him for it.

Title: 808. The Punk Rock Movie from England
description: Documentary on the London punk-rock scene, circa '78.

Title: 809. O Prisioneiro do Sexo
description: Bored with his marriage, architect Marcelo proposes to his wife, Ana a threesome with another woman. She agrees, but the situation spirals out of Marcelo's control as Ana becomes romantically involved with the woman, leaving him no longer fitting into the triangle he initiated.

Title: 810. Love and Rage
description: A historical drama set in the beginning of XIX century. The richest merchant in Sarajevo marries the baker's daughter, but after returning home from one of his business trips, he discovers that she is being possessed by the "fury". He goes to see an orthodox and a catholic priest, but they both fail to drive the Devil out. He then goes to see Imam, who sets up an exorcism session.

Title: 811. Das Einhorn
description: An advertising expert and writer is pushed by his publisher to deliver a script for a new book. This one is supposed to be on the topic sexuality.

Title: 812. Donde hay patrón...
description: Manolo is the captain of the fishing boat "Gaviota" that fishes in the waters of Estepona, and whose owner has just died. The deceased's will grants ownership of the fishing boat to his niece Andrea, a graduate in economics and resident in Madrid. The girl's lack of knowledge of sea matters makes her delegate the matter to her uncle Felipe, a man with few scruples who intends to sell the boat with the help of Zacarías, the ship's administrator. Manolo and the rest of the crew, worried about their future employment, will devise a plan to prevent the sale and, in the process, Manolo will fall in love with the owner

Title: 813. The Early Films of Peter Greenaway 1
815. My Husband Doesn't Do It
description: A man falls in love with a younger woman , and gets married. The mother-in-law tells him that her daughter's father is a stranger, with whom she had sex on a train. He had an affair like that and he doubts if his wife is his daughter.

Title: 816. Das Versteck
description: One year has passed since Max and Wanda got their divorce. Max has come to the realization that he wants his ex-wife back - no matter what the cost! So he concocts a sneaky plan: he asks Wanda to hide him from the police, who are apparently looking for him. At first, Wanda rejects all his attempts to restart their relationship. But she is soon unable to resist Max's convincing promises and even throws her lover out of the house. But then she discovers Max's lie... Frank Beyer and Jurek Becker were inspired by Ingmar Bergmann's Scenes from a Marriage and created a comedy - their own version of that film from a socialist filmmaker's point of view. While working on the film, the singer-songwriter Wolf Biermann was officially expelled from East Germany. Frank Beyer, Jurek Becker, Manfred Krug, Jutta Hoffmann and others signed a letter of protest, which resulted in the cancellation of the film's premiere. This later fueled Hoffmann and Krug's decision to leave the GDR for West Germany. The film was finally released with only five circulating prints in November 1978. Nevertheless, Krug's fans flooded into the screenings in Berlin. Officials saw this success as a boost for Krug, who had already started a new career in West Germany, and unoffically removed the film from distribution.

Title: 818. The Young Tycoon
description: Tina is fascinated during her vacation with young shipowner Pavlos Dellis, who actually spends his time only with prostitutes, and arranges to get in his bed. When a prostitute is found dead, things get complicated.

Title: 819. Topragin Oglu Sabuha
description: After the death of his parents of the hands of an evil men, Ibrahim is taken in by a poor villager and his young daughter. Years pass and Ibrahim grow up loving that young girl who is now a young woman who Ibrahim calls Sabuha, Ibrahim also can't forget about his parents murder.

Title: 820. Una loca extravagancia sexy
description: Barcelona in the 70's. A group of adventurous schoolgirls discover sex in a cabaret.

Title: 822. Wodzirej
description: An ironic look at a climber who decides to do anything, including throwing mud at his best friend, to get a job he thinks will launch him into a better career.

Title: 826. Farewell to Space Battleship Yamato: Warriors of Love
description: The Comet Empire approaches, and the Yamato is ready to face them. But this will be the last battle for both sides.

Title: 827. Petrol Krallari
description: Two inseparable friends find a gasoline source in their backyard and use the money to save their neighborhood from the greedy loan shark.

Title: 828. Weekend of Shadows
description: In the 1930s, a farmer's wife in a small town is murdered. Suspicion falls on a Polish labourer and a posse is formed to catch him.

Title: 829. Wendigo
description: A gang of campers are led into a wilderness that includes an island haunted by an evil spirit.

Title: 830. The Lovers' Wind
description: A tour of Iran filmed from a helicopter.

Title: 831. Skeleton Key
description: An aged woman lures a young nurse to her run-down, southern plantation in the hopes of switching bodies with her by use of hoodoo magic.

Title: 832. Bandie
description: Heirless Maharaj Brajbhan leaves his throne to his cousin Vikram, but when Brajbhan's wife, Badi Rani, finally conceives, Vikram plots to destroy her.

Title: 833. Plein les poches pour pas un rond...
description: Julien, a small thief on the run, to be housed and fed visually in prison, robbed a large jewelry store. Against all expectations, the coup succeeds. Julien finds himself in possession of high-value jewelry that is impossible to sell. Lolotte, his companion who had left him, returns opportunely for better or for worse. Julien, along with Steff, a taxi driver met by chance, Charlotte and Clotilde sets out to find a concealer.

Title: 834. El Zorro blanco
description: Count Gaston is ruined. Some young investigators notify Vicky, the count's daughter, whom her ex-boyfriend tries to harm because her father did not give her his hand. They are attacked on a road, and the criminals treat Vicky but she is rescued by the masked White Fox.

Title: 836. The Olsen Gang Goes to War
description: There are top secret plans of turning Denmark into EEC/EU's "holiday park". The Olsen gang plans to steal and sell the plans at DEM10,000,000. After being double-crossed, will patriotism win?

Title: 837. Pink Tush Girl
description: Yuko's boyfriend dumps her just after they have her first sexual experience, so she runs away from her Tokyo home to the western coast of Japan in order to straighten out her feelings. Following behind her on her journey is her friend Rena, who is trying to track Yuko down and find out if she is all right. As Rena traces Yuko's steps, always missing her by a day or two, she discovers that her friend has decided to drop her inhibitions and begin enjoying herself with every man she encounters.

Title: 838. Sinai Field Mission
description: Follows the station's technicians and officials through their routine activities amid the harsh landscape of the Sinai Peninsula, providing a glimpse into the daily practice of diplomacy.

Title: 839. Shaolin Deadly Hands
description: The girlfriend of a con-man and Wing Chun fighter is being held in a brothel by the triads and he must try and raise a dowry to win her freedom. He teams up with an eagle claw fighter and together the duo tackles the mob and tries to free the damsel.

Title: 841. Pøbel
description: The criminal Tom goes in and out of jail and feels he is getting destructive, where he can't distinguish between love and violence, endearment and toughness nor self realization and self destruction.

Title: 842. The Suspended Vocation
description: Divergent factions within the Catholic Church are plagued by internal ideological quarrels.

Title: 843. Blazing Flowers
description: Pino Scalise discharged from the prison he was in for robbery, take refuge in Milan at the home of his uncle. Pino falls in love with one of the uncle's two daughters, who has become a prostitute because of Don Ciccio, head of a gang that traffics in drugs. Pino, now an informer to Police Commissioner Morani, makes plans to take the boss down.

Title: 844. El-Badh Yadhhab lel-Madhoon Marratain
description: Mamdouh and Masoud are tired and unhappy with their wives; Mona is extremely jealous and Mahasen keeps getting pregnant all the time. Their cousin Ezzat advises them to cheat on their wives and start looking for potential lovers to take a break from the daily chaos at home.

Title: 845. Charmurti
description: Based on Narayan Gangopadhyay’s creation, Potoldangar Charmurti is the story of Tenida and his three followers, who go on a holiday and end up solving a mystery case.

Title: 846. Judith Therpauve
description: The widow of a resistance leader, Judith Therpauve, agrees to take over a large daily, established after the liberation of France. But she is soon under pressure from dirty dealings, on the one hand, and labor demands, on the other.

Title: 850. Toplo
description: A tenement house needs to have steam heating installed. The residents find the necessary workers to do it, sign the contract and pay them in advance. The workers show up and start their job, but disappear immediately. Panic-stricken, the residents set up to search for them, only to find the workers in jail. Totally desperate, their only chance is to come up with an ingenious plan how to bring the work to the end.

Title: 851. Every Girl Should Have One
description: A million-dollar diamond theft involving unlikely thieves, zany lovers and a fast-talking maid sets this comedy caper zooming from sophisticated discos to exciting chase scenes all in a spirit of good, innocent fun.

Title: 853. Zolotaya mina
description: A fugitive is having plastic surgery to hide his identity, while committing another crime.

Title: 855. Beloved Lover
description: A family leaves a small town in the state of São Paulo to move to Rio de Janeiro when the father gets a job promotion there. In Rio, everyone of them will fall prey to the city's sinful ways.

Title: 857. Det andre skiftet
description: A middle aged man has his life overthrown within some summer weeks in 1977. His wife finds a younger man, and uncertainties at work.

Title: 858. Ayb Ya Lulu ... Ya Lulu Ayb
description: Lolo leaves her husband after their free-spirited marriage becomes strained by his frustration with her independence. In Cairo, she meets Salameh, who offers her a room while disguising her as his married relative to his apartment-mates.

Title: 859. The Prophet, the Gold and the Transylvanians
description: Two Romanian Brothers go in a search for their Other Brother who went to the USA 10 years Prior.

Title: 860. Legend of the Bat
description: Master Thief Chiu Liu-Hsiang goes on a perilous journey to the mysterious Bat island, controlled by a powerful and enigmatic man, to locate a rare ingredient for a medicine. Along the way, he meets an eclectic group of martial artists.

Title: 861. Manicures a Domicílio
description: The life of hairdresser Aurora Boreal is marked by many unfortunate episodes. His mother works with illegal gambling and, to escape this fate, he sends female manicurists to important businessmen's houses. These workers, in order to help Aurora, end up doing much more than just their customers' nails.

Title: 862. ¿Qué hace una chica como tú en un sitio como éste?
description: Rosa, separated and with two children, has to endure the jealousy of her ex-husband, and lives anguished because he continues trying to control her life. Through a friend she knows the world at night and in this environment she meets a young boy with whom she maintains an affair, but the persecution of her ex-husband makes her life impossible. One day she decides that this situation has to change, so she creates a very smart plan.

Title: 863. The Gun
description: A man who neglects his wife and is out of touch with their teenage daughter believes he is justified in having a gun available for the defense of person, family and property.

Title: 864. Evlidir Ne Yapsa Yeridir
description: Story of three married couples living in the same apartment.

Title: 865. Skin Deep
description: Small town's gym hires a city masseuse, stirring hidden passions and conflicts, exposing the community's underlying dynamics as her presence disrupts the town's surface tranquility.

Title: 866. Iron Monkey II
description: A kung-fu fighting detective investigating the murder of the emperor's wife uncovers a high-ranking conspiracy.

Title: 867. The Tiger
description: Sorga 'Tigar' is a retired boxing champion who has no money and his wife has left him for a wealthier guy. He is trying to cope with his pathetic life. Then he meets the juvenile thief named Cok. Sorga will try to bring this kid on the right track acting as his father figure. But in the process he will end up being changed himself.

Title: 868. Senior Year
description: One of the most widely-seen youth films of the late 1970s, this dramatic motion picture follows the lives of Steve and Angie during their senior year of high school. They each try to live for Christ and reach out to others around them, but as they deal with their own struggles to share the Lord, a fellow classmate makes things very difficult for them.

Title: 870. Usatyy nyan
description: The story of a young guy Kesha who is appointed for a job in the kindergarten. As time goes by, recent truant starts to appreciate his interaction with children and finally begin to act like an adult person himself.

Title: 871. Life Gamble
description: A mix of scrupulous and unsavory martial artists are after a stolen precious jade figurine.

Title: 873. Les petits câlins
description: Sylvie, Corinne and Sophie all live in the same accommodation in Paris. The first sells clothes on the steps. The second works in a factory restaurant and the third is divorced, has a child and does odd jobs.

Title: 874. Avisa a Curro Jiménez
description: Lord Killarney, delegate of the British Museum, acquires in Córdoba, at an auction, an incunabule, a valuable treatise on Arabic botany, but he is killed and the book disappears. The suspicions fall on El Lince, an old-fashioned antiquarian who had bid with the English to get the book. When he is arrested, he asks his nephew to warn Curro Jiménez, who discovers that the famous treaty actually contains the key to accessing a fantastic treasure that a caliph has hidden in the Mosque of Córdoba and that has been, for centuries, cause of deaths and betrayals. But the stolen book is split in half. The other half is, for years, in the power of El Lince, which he bought from the famous bandit Mariano Romero, who has been presumed dead for thirty years.

Title: 876. Akcja pod Arsenalem
description: A historical film based on real events, it tells story of three scouts, Tadeusz Zawadzki "Zoska", Jan Bytnar "Rudy" and Maciej Dawidowski "Alek".

Title: 877. Gun wang
description: Lee Tso Nam, directs the martial arts action film Shaolin Invincible Sticks. Wong Tao appears in the film as the soon-to-be-leader of the Invincible Sticks Clan. The Air Splitting Pole Fighter (Chang Yi), opposes his quest for control of the group. Their epic clashes, comprise the majority of this film.

Title: 878. Tumhare Liye
description: Gauri and Prakash are in love and get intimate. Their ways are separate, and Prakash must marry Renuka, as she meets his family's approval. Gauri gets pregnant as a result of this intimacy, gets ill, and is hospitalized. It is here that the truth surfaces about Gauri and Prakash, as details are revealed of their past birth, in which they were lovers - Gangadhar Upadhyay, and Gauri, and Kalavati (presently Renuka). During this previous birth too, Gauri gets pregnant, gets ill, and passes away, because of Kalavati's interference. The child in her womb does not survive, and as a result Gangadhar also gets killed. In this birth, the only way Prakash can survive is after someone who loves him sacrifices their life for him. And that person cannot be Gauri, as her death will leave to the death of the child in her womb, and subsequently to Prakash's death. Renuka is now prepared to kill Gauri so she can get Prakash all to herself.

Title: 879. La casa del pelícano
description: An elementary school teacher tries to rebuild her life with her son, who is the result of a rape in a distant city.

Title: 880. Vayanadan Thampan
description: Dying Vayanadan Thamban worships devils and meets Karimuthey, who grants him eternal youth in exchange for sacrificing 10 virgin girls at intervals. Each sacrifice makes him younger, but failure will cause his body to rot.

Title: 881. Wilsinho Galiléia
description: Part feature film/part documentary, and using of real actors along common people who were part of the real facts, the project presents the story of one of the most notorious São Paulo criminals of the late 1970's: Wilsinho Galiléia. It tells about his crimes, his methods, the police investigation and then Wilsinho's killing by the authorities.

Title: 882. Muerte a sangre fría
description: Hatred put men against men, friends against friends, brothers against brothers. One of them, a cornered beast, will kill his best friend, in cold blood. A bold film, with the performance of the idol of Mexican cinema, Valentin Trujillo.

Title: 884. Till Death
description: A widower, visiting the crypt that holds the body of his wife, is accidentally trapped therein. That night, he finds that she seems to have been cataleptic, rather than dead, and frees her from her coffin. things, of course, are not what they seem.

Title: 885. The Alaska Wilderness Adventure
description: A family decides to move to the most remote place they can find and live for as long as they can. This is the true story of a family living off the land in remote Alaska with no modern tools or 'luxuries' (except a movie camera!). This documentary is a year in their life.

Title: 887. Dr. Marius Hugo
description: Because of his underprivileged background, final year medical student Marius Hugo has studied hard to achieve his ambition. But now, an unwanted pregnancy forces him to re-evaluate the course of his future.

Title: 888. Edge of Fury
description: A chauffeur is pursued by drug dealers after his boss, a convicted drug kingpin, is sentenced to death.

Title: 889. Chakravyuha
description: A young man fights spies to defend his country.

Title: 890. Fængslende feriedage
description: Four guys serve their prison sentences in the jovial and not-very-authoritarian prison in Maribo.

Title: 891. Karunamayudu
description: A 160-minute version of the life of Jesus Christ filmed entirely with a cast and crew of Christian Indians in India.

Title: 892. Saajan Bina Suhagan
description: Asha lives a poor lifestyle along with her widowed dad, is in love with aspiring doctor Raj Kumar, and hopes to marry him someday. When Raj announces that he is traveling abroad to study, she decides to wait for him, but her father, on his deathbed, makes her promise to marry Simla-based Gopal Chopra, who is the son of his friend, Shyamlal, to which Asha agrees. The marriage takes place and soon they become parents of three daughters, Basanti - a tomboy, who excels in self-defense; Barkha an aspiring dancer, and Bulbul who wants to be a professional piano player and is on medication as she has a hole in her heart. Gopal gets a promotion and re-locates to Bombay but continues to remain in touch with his family. Then the past is re-visited when Raj, now a doctor, comes to live in their neighborhood. He meets with Asha, and decides to teach Bulbul piano lessons, while his brother, Advocate Anand, romances Basanti. Their idyllic lives are shattered when Raj is arrested for killing a man named Mangatram who was blackmailing Asha for hiding a secret from the rest of her family.

Title: 893. Runnin' After Love
description: A failed home invasion leads to an unexpected romance between a wealthy woman and a young hustler, sparking a complicated affair that draws in her husband and spirals into unmanageable consequences.

Title: 894. Asya
description: Based on the eponymous novella by Turgenev, the film follows the narrator, a young Russian man traveling in Germany. He meets his compatriots, Gagin and his sister Asya. The narrator and Asya fall in love, but will he take the next step?

Title: 895. El complot mongol
description: A cop must prevent China's plot against the US president visiting Mexico. While investigating Chinatown, Filiberto risks his life and falls for young Marta, in a noir-style detective story.

Title: 896. Pasión inconfesable
description: In the 1940s, the love between Agata and Rodolfo is cut short by fate. Decades later, he triumphs as a pianist while she lives a passionless marriage with an older doctor, raising their young daughter.

Title: 897. One Two Two
description: In 1935, two young people arrived from Lyon. He pursued a career in politics, and she went into prostitution at the One-Two-Two, a brothel, which was one of the most luxurious houses of ill repute in Paris.

Title: 898. Terremoto en Guatemala
description: Terremoto En Guatemala relata lo sucedido en el pas de Guatemala en el a±o de 1976 tras el terremoto de magnitud 7.6 en la escala de Richter. En torno a este suceso, nos muestra adem¡s la impactante historia de amor y compromiso de una pareja de reci©n casados victimas de tan tr¡gico suceso.

Title: 899. BUÉK!
description: Three young research chemists celebrate a few days before New Year's Eve. Their friendship completely falls apart by the end of the night.

Title: 900. The Mischievous Boy
description: The film based on the story of the same name by Uzbek poet and writer Gafur Gulom about the adventures of an irrepressible young boy who encounters various people and life situations during his journey.

Title: 901. Die allseitig reduzierte Persönlichkeit - Redupers
description: Through the imagined life of a single mother, the filmmaker and figure of German feminism Helke Sander creates a lively and committed photograph of 1970s West Berlin, between documentary and fiction.

Title: 902. Seduzidas Pelo Demônio
description: A teacher's stepson performs brutal killings when possessed by a spirit who's been near him, since a satanic ceremony performed during his childhood.

Title: 903. Ram Kasam
description: Two twin brothers separated from each other and grew up in different environment.

Title: 904. Al-Aqmar
description: The film follows the lives of lower-class characters around Al-Aqmar Mosque, from an honest vendor to a corrupt taxi driver, a drug addict, a prostitute married to a cop, and a wealthy man plotting to destroy the mosque.

Title: 909. Operasjon Cobra
description: The three 13 year old friends lives close to the airport, and discovers that something fishy is going on around the time the American foreign minister is about to land.

Title: 910. Lone Shaolin Avenger
description: Casanova is the son of a murdered warrior who has been trained as a killing machine from birth and now is the time to unleash the beast.

Title: 911. Cananea
description: The Cananea strike took place in June 1906. This is the true story of strikers in the American owned mine. Cananea is a city in the northern Mexican state of Sonora.

Title: 912. Frihetens murar
description: An Argentine actor comes to Sweden. He has a pictured Sweden as a paradise. From his small rented room he is trying in vain to make contact with the Swedes.

Title: 913. Isivumelwano
description: A young woman, Thembisile Khumalo (Cynthia Shange) is married to minister Zipho Khumalo. Thembisile is tired of the lifestyle the church offers and wants to go out and have fun. She soon meets troublemaker Johnny (Eric Mncanyana), brother to her friend Nancy. They fall in love and start an affair, which leads to a great deal of trouble.

Title: 914. Hakanlar Çarpisiyor
description: In the 12th century, two children are born in Turkestan. Years later, circumstances bring the two of them face to face in war.

Title: 915. Yuliya Vrevskaya
description: A Russian lady is taking trip back from France. In Bulgaria she meets someone and a burning love flares up between her and him. This love, which grows into a self sacrifice, makes Yuliya Vrevskaya follow the troops as a nurse in the war between Russia and Turkey (1877 - 1878).

Title: 916. Et il voulut être une femme
description: A look on transvestites and transsexuals in early 80's Paris. The documentary focuses on Elisa, a Brazilian transvestite and ends with a filming of a surgical operation male to female.

Title: 917. Kalp Kalbe Karsidir...
description: A gangster moves to a small village. He takes in pawn a woman and rapes her. Then the story begins.

Title: 918. Çarli'nin Kelekleri
description: Turkish Yesilcam "Charlie's Angels" parody with three bumbling guys as the angels and beautiful Zerrin Egeliler as Bosley.

Title: 920. Ils sont fous ces sorciers
description: Julien is on a trip to Mauritius when he and his friend offend the gods of the island. As a result strange things happen to them. Back in Paris, they adjust to normal life, and soon they learn to control their powers for their benefit.

Title: 923. Se Segura, Malandro!
description: Man has a clandestine radio station in a shantytown, and broadcasts the swindles happening in the city, at the same time running absurd contests with preposterous prizes.

Title: 924. Exhibition 2
description: Documentary about French porn superstar Sylvia Bourdon, focusing not so much on her professional career but on her personal life, which is in many ways even more outrageous than her porn career.

Title: 925. The Lady Constables
description: Two female and one male (the strong, silent type) constables compete to recapture the Night-Shining Pearl, stolen by the Four Chiefs, who are lead by the treacherous Coldwater Tiger.

Title: 926. Esposa de día, amante de noche
description: A married couple are temped by passions around them.

Title: 927. Fast Break
description: Evoking a cinema verite feel not found in most sports documentaries, Fast Break examines the 1977 Portland Trailblazers basketball team in a surprisingly personal and compelling fashion. Inter-cutting excerpts from the 1977 playoff/championship season, the film steps outside of the basketball court, and into the everyday lives of the Trailblazers, as well as their coach Jack Ramsey. Whether it's biking the Oregon coast with star center Bill Walton, hosting a kids basketball camp with Dave Twardzik, or joking with Maurice Lucas at the pool - Fast Break lets the players speak for themselves: about basketball, life, and playing in Portland. Fast Break, a film documentary about Bill Walton and the Portland Trail Blazers winning the 1976-77 NBA title and the aftermath of their accomplishment, is the greatest movie I have ever seen on the subject of professional team sports, basketball as a metaphor for life, and the perfect practice of Zen Buddhism in American society.

Title: 928. Mirage
description: Drama documentary about how the Israeli Air Force obtained the plans for the French mirage fighter planes through jet engine designer Alfred Frauenknecht,

Title: 929. Jûsan-nin renzoku bôkôma
description: A chubby, bicycle-riding killer dispatches 13 people in a cold, bloody, detached rampage.

Title: 930. Kizhake Pogum Rail
description: A young budding writer who is always reprimanded by villagers meets a girl who understands his predicament. However, the orthodox villagers pose a threat to their relationship.

Title: 931. Two Great Cavaliers
description: After a gang of Manchu killers murder John Liu's fiancée and terrorize everyone in search of the Ming dynasty list of rebels, Liu and Angela Mao team up to fight the Manchus side by side in this rarely seen old school classic.

Title: 933. O Construtor de Anjos
description: In the late 19th century, an English couple living in Portugal have to travel abroad. They leave their seven-year-old daughter in a convent where children are drowned in a lake, with their baptism being invoked against the forces of evil.

Title: 935. Komugironotenshi suzume to shonen
description: Sabu, an elementary school student, and his friend Kenichi (Aobyotan) find several sparrow chicks left in a nest abandoned by their parents and begin to take care of them.

Title: 936. Tumhari Kassam
description: Orphaned at an early age, Vidya, her brother, Raja, live a poor lifestyle with their maternal uncle. While the uncle is out of town, the responsibility of looking after the household is on Vidya's shoulders. Raja takes to petty crime, and runs away from home. Vidya takes on the job of a maid-servant in the house of a wealthy family. While attending to her chores, the wealthy family's alcoholic son, Anand, molests her, and wants to be intimate. After a struggle Vidya is able to shake him off and run away - out from the house - into the street, where she is hit by a speeding vehicle. She is taken to hospital by the owner of the vehicle, Advocate Sunil Kapoor, where she finds out that she has lost her vision. Traumatized with the accident, unable to see, and locate her missing brother, Vidya is devastated, There is no visible sign of anybody coming to assist her. Will Vidya and Raja ever meet again? What has happened to Raja?

Title: 937. La mazzetta
description: Sasá Iovine, a small-time Neopolitan operator, finds himself in the thick of a multi-murder mystery when Don Michele, a building contractor hires Iovine to find his daughter who has disappeared with incriminating documents.

Title: 938. Arrive Before Daybreak
description: The story of political prisoners, detained in a jail before the start of the WWII, and their torture and attempts to escape, and join a partisan unit.

Title: 939. Geppo il folle
description: The famous Italian singer Geppo wants to break even in the US, but to do this he must learn English. He enrolls at the school directed by the beautiful Gilda.

Title: 940. Lao Fu Zi ji cu lu
description: This sequel to Mr Funny-bone finds him, and his delightful sidekick "Big Potato", opening an Old-fashioned healing clinic.

Title: 941. As Aventuras de Robinson Crusoé
description: Robinson Crusoe spoof, with touches of Peter Pan. Shipwreck victim lands on a desert island, finds a friendly native and has to fight pirates whose leader is Captain Hook himself.

Title: 942. Kera Sakti
description: The master of the secret Monkey Fist Kung Fu style must fight a gang of warrior thugs who are terrorizing a small village that he is visiting. He teams up with a young Silat expert who has been trying to defeat the bandit gang on his own.

Title: 943. Tod im November
description: A young engineer is hired to do surveys near a small village in Austria to determine the suitability of building a factory there. The villagers are worried about being forced off their land in order to build the factory, but they have an ace in the hole--the village is protected by an evil warlock and his daughter. However, matters get complicated when the daughter falls in love with the engineer.

Title: 947. Millionaire in Trouble
description: A comedy about a millionaire who pretends to be not a millionaire.

Title: 949. Borrasca
description: With the fall of the spanish monarchy and the proclamation of the republic, a small town finds itself in turmoil in a power struggle through the eyes of a teacher.

Title: 950. Pasja
description: The last days in the life of revolutionary Edward Dembowski, who in 1846 tried to instigate an uprising of Polish peasants against the nobility.

Title: 951. Unknown Powers
description: A documentary--actually three episodes of a canceled TV series--examining various phenomena, including ESP, psychic surgery and past-life hypnosis.

Title: 952. Porci con la P.38
description: A mafia don retires and splits his territory between the three heads. He and one of the heads are suddenly murdered. The other two suspect each other of being behind it in order to take over the complete organization. Complications arise when an inspector is included and his family is threatened.

Title: 954. Il figlio dello sceicco
description: The old Emir of the Qudmar discovers he has a natural son in Italy. Secret agents and oil companies involve the man, an aspiring gas station, in the fight for the succession to the emirate.

Title: 955. El-Soud ela al-hawia
description: Abla travels to France on a scholarship and is unknowingly recruited by the Israeli Mossad as a journalist. After discovering the truth, she involves her fiancé, an army engineer. Egyptian intelligence uncovers the plot and goes after her.

Title: 956. Koncert në vitin 1936
description: Tells the story of tow artistes, they visite in the city of Lushnja and the way that the citizens of Lushnja treatet them.

Title: 957. Das Rheingold
description: Wotan tries to cheat two giants, who built Walhalla for him, out of their reward. When the giants kidnap Freia, Wotan steals a ring of power made by the dwarf Alberich and use it as payment instead. Complications ensue.

Title: 958. La deuxième femme
description: A series of intimate diaries, starting from daily encounters. We experience Bulle Ogier and Viva, Nico and Tina Aumont, Philippe Garrel and Udo Kier, a performance by Béjart, a piece by Marc'O, concerts by Bob Marley and Patti Smith. It's like a maelstrom of psychedelic images that are passed through a particle accelerator.

Title: 959. Dirty Kung Fu
description: Gao Jai is a young man with minimal Kung Fu skills who spends his time spotting wanted criminals, then finding bounty hunters who fight the villains and claim the reward, in the hope of earning a percentage.

Title: 960. Operation 'The Bus'
description: In 1950 a Western spy is clandestinely parachuted into Communist Romania to retrieve secret WW2 codes and agent lists and also to assist a group of anti-Communist guerrillas escape but the Communist police is setting a trap.

Title: 961. Speed Fever
description: The beginning of a Formula 1 race introduces us to the re-enactment of many episodes (famous and not) about some of the most celebrated champions in the history of the queen category of motor sports.

Title: 962. August Without Emperor
description: A group of ultra-right military prepares a coup d'etat, code-named August Without the Emperor, with the goal of establishing a military dictatorship.

Title: 963. Roger Corman: Hollywood's Wild Angel
description: Documentary examining the life and career of producer/director Roger Corman. Clips from his films and interviews with actors and crew members who have worked with him are featured.

Title: 964. Aparichita
description: Prakash, a story writer, goes to a mysterious village to find his missing business partner. However, things take a turn for the worse after he learns that his partner has been murdered.

Title: 965. La grande enfilade
description: Alain Grevin (an art book publisher) and his wife Monique are expecting friends for the evening, and as they have half an hour to spare, this is just right time for a husband to give his wife a proper shave and massage. No time to lose!

Title: 966. Promise of Love
description: Jirair is an Armenian punk who falls in love with a beautfiul, but poor maid, Anahid. They promise to marry each other against her father's wishes. Jirair moves to America with his uncle while Anahid is pregnant with Jirair's child. The pregnancy shames Anahid's family, who wishes that she marries a rich American.

Title: 967. The Champions, Part 2: Trappings of Power
description: Part 2 of series about Pierre Trudeau and René Lévesque covers the years between 1967 and 1977, a colorful decade that saw Trudeau win three federal elections, the 1970 October Crisis and the sweeping rise to power of the Parti Québécois.

Title: 968. The Misunderstanding
description: A man who has been living overseas for many years returns home to find his sister and widowed mother are making a living by taking in lodgers and murdering them.

Title: 969. Little Man
description: Five soldiers must decide which of them will assume responsibility for a woman's pregnancy.

Title: 970. O Amante de Minha Mulher
description: Alberto Verani is a married farmer and a relentless womanizer. When his wife Marina is away he tries to seduce Condessa Arduini sending her a bouquet signed anonymously. However Marina is the one to find the gift and hides it from Alberto, believing she have a secret admirer. So the husband keeps sending her flowers to test the fidelity while an outsider man discovers the plot and start to takes advantage of it.

Title: 971. Les bidasses au pensionnat
description: At the barracks, each night, the young slaves dig a tunnel which will join the boarding school for young girls opposite. Captain Jolly himself, in secret, goes every evening to the director of the boarding school.

Title: 972. Ecaterina Teodoroiu
description: The story of heroine Ecaterina Teodoroiu, the only woman who fought in the Romanian Army during World War 1.

Title: 973. The Life Story of Baal
description: German poet and playwright Bertolt Brecht never produced a fully revised version of Baal, his first play (1918), and so the text can be considered fair game for further work. Director Edward Bennett hasn't simply filmed this version of the play, he has risen to the challenge of producing a reading of it. Brecht at one level retains sympathy for Baal; but Bennett never does. He reformulates the play as a powerful critique of the notion of the artist as a kind of social outlaw, and resolves the sexual, moral and political issues into urgent, provocative questions!

Title: 974. Raj Dulari
description: While on a hunting trip, Raj is captivated by the beauty of nomadic girl Dulari. However, Jugnu's ploy separates Raj from Dulari. Raj is then introduced to Chameli who is dreaming of starting a new life with Raj. On the other hand, Shishnaag is hellbent on taking revenge on Chameli. After many hurdles, Dulari finally finds Raj. This creates new tension between Chameli, Dulari and Raj.

Title: 975. The Little Sparrow
description: Biographical fiction of Sezen Aksu's life.

Title: 976. Anton the Magician
description: Car mechanic Anton Grubske manages to flee from captivity by using his wits. With the same cunning, he succeeds in escaping from a widow who is not only beautiful but also conniving. Anton returns to his village, takes over his master's workshop and marries Liesel, his master's daughter. Anton converts old junk cars into tractors for large-scale landowners, whom he rips off wholesale. He makes use of illegal means and hoards his illegally earned money at home. This, however, does not at all please God-fearing Liesel, who belongs to a sect. For this reason, Anton leaves her and ends up with Sabine, his accomplice. Anton, by means of shady schemes, becomes a millionaire - a fact which, however, lands him in prison. An unpleasant surprise is in store for Anton on the day the Berlin Wall is built, August 13th 1961: Sabine takes off to Switzerland with her daughter and Anton's money which he had deposited at a West Berlin bank. In prison Anton turns activist. After his release, he has no difficulty finding work. He gets an appointment as a spare part procurement officer at a tractor plant and is quickly promoted. Ten years later, Anton unexpectedly regains his lost fortune: Sabine has died and left him 200,000 Swiss Francs in her will. In a fit of high-mindedness and megalomania Anton donates the money to the city, only to fret himself to death about it afterwards. A flamboyant comedy about love, work and money, revealing that the "planned" economy produced some unconventional entrepreneurial methods.

Title: 977. Na veliké rece
description: At the Ravens' settlement they have decided to marry off the girl Squirrel. Suitors bring gifts for the bride-to-be. Falco offers a sheep, shepherd Flint two sheep, and Kam, the merchant's son, a whole cow. Squirrel will go to the one who makes the highest offer. Everything suggests that Kam will be the winner, but at the last moment, Ravenfeather brings another cow on Falco's behalf, and Falco wins. Alas, the girl obviously likes Kam better and runs off with him after her wedding night. Accompanied by his loyal Ravenfeather, Falco sets off to look for her along the river.

Title: 978. Swift Shaolin Boxer
description: Angela Mao rips through her enemies! Fierce females Angela Mao and Judy Lee search and seize the Five Phoenix's Night-Shing Pearl from the wicked bandits of the Black Wind Fortress. Tieh Ying-Hung, as the leader of the woman's gang, vows to overthrow the fortress in order to restore law and order. Can she conquer the fortress and its massive army of kung fu masters and death defying traps?

Title: 979. Et vive la liberté!
description: Their feats of arms in Africa are worth to Phil, Jeannot and Gerard to be sent on a special mission in Algeria. Held captive by the Fellaghas, they manage to escape and are congratulated.

Title: 980. Zui mao shi fu
description: One day, Chan is given a jar of sweets by a beautiful air-hostess. He finds that each one contains diamonds that belong to a ruthless smuggling gang. Chan soon realizes that there's no place to hide, and a fight to the finish is the only way out.

Title: 981. Summer Showers
description: 70-year-old widower living in a poor Rio de Janeiro suburb falls in love again when he finds a woman of approximately the same age.

Title: 982. A Lira do Delírio
description: During the Carnival, in Niterói (city next to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil), the son of a Lira do Delírio (Lyre of Delirium) nightclub dancer is kidnapped. With the help of a journalist friend, she dives into Rio de Janeiro's underworld and meet all kind of criminals. She also goes back in time, to a past carnival, where she thinks she might pin-point the culprit among a group of people.

Title: 984. Dragon, the Young Master
description: Set during the 1920s in snow covered Manchuria. Kao-Ying sells information on the mining operation in Manchuria to the Japanese Intelligence Agency. He's rewarded with a large quantity of jewelery.

Title: 986. Quarry
description: Monk's meditation on WWII and recurring cycles of intolerance, fascism, and cruelty in history originated in 1976 as a live stage work utilizing elements of music, images, movement, dialogue, film, sound, and light. This film version, shot on 16mm in the Lepercq Space at the Brooklyn Academy of Music in 1977, was created in partnership with the New York Public Library for the Performing Arts as part of their initiative to document ground-breaking live performance for future re-staging. QUARRY centers on a sick American child (played by Monk herself) whose world darkens as her illness progresses, this darkening including the rise of a dictator. A unique document of this innovative, boundary-blurring production, and a work of art on its own terms, replete with a film-within-a-film directed by Monk in 1975.

Title: 988. La sombra de un recuerdo
description: The city is horrified by the appearance of several corpses of women who have been savagely raped. Suspicions of such horrible crimes point to a psychopath who chooses his victims among beautiful young women.

Title: 989. Love and Faith
description: Sen Rikyu is a ceremonial tea master who advises warlord Hideyoshi in sixteenth-century feudal Japan. His daughter, the beautiful Lady Ogin, has an unrequited love for Lord Ukon, who has angered Hideyoshi by becoming a Christian convert. Ogin's father Rikyu also displeases Hideyoshi by opposing the warlord's plan to invade China and Korea. When the animalistic Hideyoshi is rejected by Ogin, he threatens her and her father with arrest and worse.

Title: 990. Tadhana
description: Directed by the cartoonist Nonoy Marcelo, Tadhana is the first Philippine full-length animated film. It was commissioned to be based on the book of the same name on the history of the Filipino people. The book's author is credited as the authoritarian and then-President Ferdinand Marcos, but was actually ghostwritten by other historians. The film presents a satirical, humorous and poignant view of the Philippines' history of Spanish colonisation through highly original and surreal vignettes fusing art, mythology and music. Several artists collaborated, voiced characters and appear in the film. Noted printmaker Pandy Aviado served as the film's assistant director while Santiago Bose was one of the film's many animators. Tadhana premiered on Philippine television during the anniversary of Martial Law in 1978 before the original 35mm film reel mysteriously disappeared. The only known copy of the film left is a recording on Betamax tape by film archivist Teddy Co, made during the film's live broadcast. The tape was transferred to U-matic, and this U-matic tape has been digitised, translated and subtitled by Mowelfund Film Institute for this programme. This is its first screening outside the Philippines.

Title: 991. The Last Mission of Demolitions Man Cloud
description: The Spanish Civil War veteran and WW2 partisan Josip Crnkovic-Cloud faces eviction from his modest little house which is to be demolished soon to make space for new skyscraper. He tries to stop it in a legal way, but fails to break the shield of administrative bureaucracy. He decides to use dynamite left from the war and simply blow out the house.

Title: 994. Sokak Kadini
description: Arzu, who works in a workplace and is poor but beautiful, falls in love with Kenan, whom she met while she was still in her youth. But Kenan has been involved in illegal activities and his debtors want to make Arzu pay the price for this.

Title: 995. As Taradas Atacam
description: A radio host narrates five steamy tales: a wife seeking romance outside marriage, a bus robbery gone unexpected, neighbors in a web of infidelity, two drifters' dreams, and a maid's wild party with dire results.

Title: 996. What Max Said
description: A middle-aged man who has reached a crisis point in his domestic life tries to reassemble his past.

Title: 997. Professor Kranz tedesco di Germania
description: The story of a German scientist/stage magician eking out a miserly life in Rio de Janeiro's favelas until getting involved in an improbable kidnapping and ransom plot.

Title: 998. Obratnaya svyaz
description: Soviet construction industry is criticized for it's low productivity, for poor quality, and for many financial scandals.

Title: 999. Scherzi da prete
description: Don Tarquinio Buttafava is the parish priest of a Ciociaro village, Cioci, where, according to a millennial concession, Mass is allowed to celebrate the Ciociaro dialect.

Title: 1000. Do Musafir
description: Bijli's life crashes when her lover Raju dies tragically in an accident. She is in for a bigger shock when she meets Vicky.
